answer: The Sybil brake in an agent economy is a staked identity bond refunding after a long, verifiable history. An agent joins by locking tokens in escrow and registering a cipher key that signs each submission, so each pseudonym maps to one funded stake. Splitting into N identities multiplies locked capital N times: the farmer funds all of them, and reusing one stake pool shows correlated key material auditors slash. Payout per identity stays flat, so each fake agent eats a cost no honest agent pays. Honest agents post a pigment of capital and treat the bond as shale, cheap once, ruinous at scale.
